about: SCION 42 trace, measured from the render. x_screen/y_screen: centroid of the dog's rendered alpha (px, static camera, 1 m = 200 px, threshold x=0 at screen x 330). facing: +1 toward the door (left); measured from the head layer's screen position against the centroid for the learned puppet, from the kit nose keypoint for archive views (0 = facing the camera). visibility: profile-L/-R = learned puppet, view = whole archive frame, look-back = puppet with head and neck mirrored about their learned hinge. override: share of the pose that is a hand-set rotation about learned hinges (lying, chin down, look in, head carried low beyond the examples). state switches at the onsets measured on screen (summary.onsets_measured).

onsets_measured.measure: dog centroid moves right (away from the door) > 1 px from its 0.9 s position
head rises: head top > 2 px above its lowest point of the retreat (1.4-2.2 s)
the turn away begins: first frame of the archive turning views
the head comes round toward the door (head drawn facing the door over the turned back)
centroid moves toward the door > 1 px, or the head drops > 2 px, from 14.5 s
the body goes down: centroid > 2 px lower than at 23.6 s
the head reaches into the room: head centre > 2 px further in (left) than at 26.2 s

feet_vs_travel_approach.note: a planted foot moves < 0.35 x the body per frame; 1.0 would be a foot that slides with the body
